From Purple Haze · Price: the virus hits allies and you too.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: break a capsule in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-ft burst}: persistent poison damage equal to @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[poison]], and @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[poison]] at once as the virus bites (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates); a failure also leaves the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}, a critical failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2}; including allies and you. Or, 1 action: your stand's fist breaks a capsule on one creature it hits or touches, so only that creature is exposed: the bite's @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[poison]] is a @Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude} save, and a failure brings the persistent damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened} as above.
  • 5: Persistent damage equals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[poison]]. The virus's bite at once deals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[poison]].
  • 9: Surge: three capsules at once, each in a different burst.
  • 13: 1 action: kill your virus in one burst, ending its persistent damage on everyone there (the virus also dies in direct sunlight). The virus has adapted: a failure leaves a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2}, a critical failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 3}.
  • 17: A failure also makes the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1}, and a critical failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
